title: Evidence timestamps wired correctly
details: Fixes the remaining Android evidence-viewer fault shown in the latest recording: Milos was still playing the 10-second introduction while LO timestamp rows were tapped
The direct timestamp repair is now applied while the evidence HTML is still being assembled, before the ZIP is finalised, so it is actually present in exported evidence
Tapping an AC now selects the correct LO recording first and then seeks the real video element to that AC time
The unsuccessful 2.73 runtime position has been retired from the live shell rather than layered on top
The streamlined Android ZIP flow, fixed-video scrolling layout and proven 2.46 camera/media recording stack are unchanged
